author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current figure crouched with splayed legs, and its bat started at the hand as a bent continuation of the arm, so it read as someone dancing or waving. Redrawn to the reference stance: upright torso, legs apart, arms reaching across to the hands at the left. The bat is one long straight line through the hands, with the knob poking out below and the barrel rising steeply beside the head, so it reads as a held bat.
omissions: The outlined body and the bat's thickness were dropped: stick-figure style with a stroke bat.
